What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Our warranty covers defects in materials or workmanship under normal household use. The coverage period depends on the item:



Warmers bought before March 20, 2026: 1 year from purchase.


Warmers bought on or after March 20, 2026: 6 months from purchase. Registering within 60 days makes the warmer eligible for a free 2-year limited warranty.


Warmer lightbulbs: 90 days from purchase.


Silicone dishes: 6 months from purchase.



During the initial warranty period, the manufacturer replaces products or parts affected by manufacturing defects at no charge. During the extended limited warranty period, replacements for those defects are available at a 50% discount. The warranty doesn’t cover accidental damage, abuse, neglect, incorrect voltage, attempted repairs, or loss or theft.
You can read the full details on our Shipping, Warranty, & Returns page. If you tell me which item is defective and when you bought it, I can help narrow down what applies.
